description: Save ONE post to the brand’s X bookmarks (private to the account), or remove it with undo:true. One post per call. Needs the bookmark.write permission: an X connection made before 2026-11-15 must be reconnected once under Connectors > X (the tool says so without calling X). Costs credits (X bills per API call).

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

postId.description: the post’s id, or its x.com link

name: bookmark_x_post
title: Bookmark a post on X
